notes.subject: merĩkanyĩtwo
notes.rationale: פקד לũguo 'kũrekania/kũmundũka' — kũrekania andũ nĩ gwĩka kwa kĩrĩkanĩro, ti kaingĩ ta 'kũigua'

notes.subject: na
notes.rationale: Hebrew ו prefix glossed as Gĩkũyũ copula 'maarĩ' to introduce the count

notes.subject: census count
notes.rationale: Census tally of the tribe of Judah: 74,600

translation: Arĩa merĩkanyĩtwo, a mũciĩ wa Yehuda, maarĩ ihĩtũ na mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano cia ngiri ĩgĩrĩ — ngiri inyanya mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ĩtĩrĩtu, mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano — arĩmi ngiri ĩgĩrĩ na mĩrongo ĩrĩ, na mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ĩtatu ũmwe; ndĩrĩ ta ũguo — ithaa rĩu: arĩa merĩkanyĩtwo a mũciĩ wa Yehuda maarĩ ngiri ĩgĩrĩ mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano (74) na ngiri ĩgĩrĩ mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ĩtatu ũmwe — ithaa rĩu: ihĩtũ na mĩrongo ĩrĩ (4 mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano = 74) ngiri ĩgĩrĩ, na mĩrongo ĩrĩ, ũhoro ũrĩa: arĩa merĩkanyĩtwo a mũciĩ wa Yehuda maarĩ 74,600 — ihĩtũ na mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ithano ngiri ĩgĩrĩ, na mĩrongo ĩrĩ na ĩtatu ngiri ĩmwe.
